newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: UAE youths stranded in Gaza after Israeli closure.
newsitem.headline: UAE youths stranded in Gaza after Israeli closure.

text.p: The United Arab Emirates has asked Egypt and the Palestinian Authority to help a UAE youth team stranded in self-ruled Gaza by an Israeli closure return home, a UAE official said on Tuesday.

"The UAE Foreign Ministry is concerned with the case of the youths who are unable to leave Gaza and has asked our embassy in Cairo to follow up the case with the Egyptian and Palestinian authorities," the official told Reuters.

He said six young UAE men, taking part in a Palestinian youth camp since July 17, were trapped in Gaza after Israel imposed a closure on the area following a double suicide bombing last week that killed 13 people in Jewish West Jerusalem.
The UAE has no relations with Israel.
UAE newspapers said on Tuesday that a 10-member Qatari delegation was also trapped in Gaza.
